sql_calls.sql:
SELECT grn_id, shipment_id, line, received_ts, asn_sku, asn_units, sku_booked, units_booked
FROM store.goods_receipts
WHERE asn_sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' OR sku_booked='ATTA-WW-5KG'
ORDER BY received_ts;

SELECT sku_scanned, count(*) AS lines, sum(qty) AS units, count(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills,
       min(bill_ts) AS first_ts, max(bill_ts) AS last_ts
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned LIKE 'ATTA%'
GROUP BY sku_scanned ORDER BY sku_scanned;

SELECT d.date,
       d.units_sold AS ds_units,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM store.pos_lines p WHERE p.sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND p.bill_ts::date=d.date) AS pos_lines_5kg,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM store.pos_lines p WHERE p.bill_ts::date=d.date) AS all_pos_lines,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT p.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines p WHERE p.bill_ts::date=d.date) AS bills,
       ib.book_on_hand_close
FROM store.daily_sales d
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book ib ON ib.date=d.date AND ib.sku=d.sku
WHERE d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND d.date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY d.date;

SELECT d.date,
       sum(CASE WHEN d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' THEN d.units_sold END) AS a5,
       sum(CASE WHEN d.sku='ATTA-WW-1KG' THEN d.units_sold END) AS a1,
       sum(CASE WHEN d.sku='ATTA-WW-10KG' THEN d.units_sold END) AS a10,
       sum(CASE WHEN d.sku='RICE-SM-5KG' THEN d.units_sold END) AS rice,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT p.bill_id) FROM payments.pos_payments p WHERE p.ts::date=d.date) AS shoppers_pay,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT p.bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines p WHERE p.bill_ts::date=d.date) AS bills_pos
FROM store.daily_sales d
WHERE d.date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date;
